faqs.a:
(a)
It shall be unlawful for the owner or custodian of any animal, excepting cats, to
               permit the same to run or go or be at large on any street or public place within the
               city, or upon the premises of any other person, without prior written permission of
               such other person.
Exception: This section shall not apply to areas designated by the city as dog training
               areas or off-leash dog park sites. At such sites, owners or custodians may allow dogs
               to run, go, or be at large off leash, subject to the following conditions. Violation
               of any of the following conditions shall constitute a violation of this section:
(1)
Owners and custodians shall not bring their dogs into the site or remain at the site
                  with their dogs after sunset or before sunrise.
(2)
Owners and custodians shall keep their dogs leashed when entering or leaving the fenced
                  enclosure of the off-leash site and must have a visible leash with them at all times.
(3)
Dogs must be accompanied by a person at least 18 years of age when inside the enclosure.
(4)
Children under the age of 18 must be supervised by a person 18 years or older.
(5)
Owners and custodians shall not allow their dogs to chase or harass wildlife or other
                  dogs.
(6)
Owners and custodians shall not leave their dogs unattended.
(7)
Owners and custodians shall immediately remove their dog's waste.
(8)
Pinch (prong) and spike collars must be removed prior to entering the enclosure.
(9)
No more than three dogs per owner or custodian are allowed.
(10)
Owners/custodians shall not bring any of the following dogs into the off-leash site:
a.
Dangerous or aggressive dogs;
b.
Female dogs in heat;
c.
Dogs without a current vaccination tag attached to the collar worn by the dogs;
d.
Dogs without a current identification tag attached to the collar worn by the dog or
                  a traceable microchip;
e.
Unvaccinated dogs;
f.
Dogs known to be ill or exhibiting signs of illness; or
g.
Dogs not under voice command, unless in areas at the site designated for training.
(11)
Any person who brings a dog to an off-leash dog park or dog training site designated
                  by the city shall be treated as the owner or custodian of the dog for purposes of
                  this section.
(12)
Anyone entering an off-leash dog park or dog training site designated by the city
                  assumes the risk of injury and property damage caused by their own dog, other dogs,
                  other persons, or any of the facilities at the site. By entering the site, every person
                  agrees to release the City of Arvada and its employees from liability for injuries
                  or property damage caused by any act or omission of the city or its employees. The
                  owner or custodian assumes liability for any injury or property damage to persons
                  or other dogs caused by their dog.
(b)
It shall be unlawful to tether any animal on any property other than that of the owner
               or custodian without prior written permission of the property owner or occupant, or
               to allow any animal tethered on the property of the owner or custodian to have access
               to property other than that of the animal owner or custodian.
(Code 1981, § 6-33; Ord. No. 3496, § 2, 12-14-1998; Ord. No. 3863, § 1, 4-12-2004;
